categories.main_business_segments: Dirui Medical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the medical device industry, focusing on in vitro diagnostic (IVD) instruments and related reagents. Its product portfolio includes seven main series: urine analysis, biochemical analysis, chemiluminescence immunoassay, gynecological secretion analysis, blood cell analysis, coagulation analysis, and integrated laboratory systems. The company develops, manufactures, markets, and services these diagnostic instruments and consumables used for routine health checks and disease diagnosis.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as automatic focusing, fuzzy logic anti-interference algorithms, planar flow cytometry, precision dosing mechanisms, high-precision laser shaping and scattering light collection, and flow imaging technology. It emphasizes modular production for instruments and quality control in reagent manufacturing. AI and deep learning, including convolutional neural networks and transfer learning, are applied for intelligent urine sediment analysis, enhancing diagnostic accuracy and efficiency. The company also holds over 130 invention patents and numerous software copyrights, reflecting strong R&D capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dirui serves hospitals, clinical laboratories, and healthcare institutions primarily in China and internationally. Its products are used for disease screening, diagnosis, treatment monitoring, and health management across various medical fields such as diabetes, cardiovascular diseases, infectious diseases, and oncology. The company’s customer base includes large public hospitals, community healthcare centers, and veterinary clinics. Internationally, it exports to approximately 125 countries and regions, focusing on both emerging and developed markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with a significant domestic market share, accounting for about 67.6% of revenue. It also has a substantial international presence, contributing roughly 32.4% of revenue, with subsidiaries and localized production in countries including India, Russia, Turkey, Thailand, Indonesia, Colombia, and the Netherlands. The international strategy focuses on localization, regulatory registration, and expanding market penetration in key countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dirui operates primarily in the midstream segment of the medical diagnostics supply chain, focusing on the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of diagnostic instruments and reagents. It manages procurement of raw materials, production, and distribution through a predominantly dealer-based sales model supplemented by direct sales. The company also emphasizes supply chain risk management and increasing the localization of raw materials and components to reduce costs and enhance supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in intelligent diagnostics, automation, and product diversification. R&D efforts focus on upgrading existing product lines, developing high-throughput and modular instruments, and expanding reagent menus. AI-driven diagnostic algorithms and integrated laboratory automation systems are key development areas. Dirui also invests in patent protection and collaborates with academic institutions to strengthen its technology platforms. The strategic roadmap includes enhancing product localization, expanding international markets, and improving digital and smart capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Dirui generates revenue primarily through the sale of medical diagnostic instruments and consumable reagents. The sales model is mainly dealer-based (over 96% of revenue) with a smaller portion from direct sales. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control to customers, typically at delivery or customer acceptance. The company also benefits from government subsidies and investment income from equity holdings. Pricing is influenced by domestic policies such as centralized procurement and import substitution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dirui is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the Chinese IVD market with a comprehensive product portfolio covering over 80% of clinical testing items. It competes with both domestic and international medical device companies, leveraging cost advantages, strong R&D, and extensive regulatory approvals. The company benefits from national policies favoring domestic substitution of imported medical devices. Its international expansion aims to strengthen competitiveness against global players by localizing production and registration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Dirui reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.22 billion, a decline of 11.63% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 141.9 million, down 48.5%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 3.1 billion with net assets of RMB 2.05 billion. Despite short-term revenue and profit declines due to macroeconomic and policy pressures, Dirui maintains a solid asset base and continues investing over 10% of revenue in R&D. The company is focused on stabilizing growth and improving profitability through strategic initiatives.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dirui emphasizes its fully independent R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, and high cost-performance ratio as key differentiators. Its products integrate advanced technologies and AI to improve diagnostic accuracy and efficiency, offering intelligent and automated solutions tailored to various clinical settings. The company’s strong patent portfolio and quality certifications (ISO, CE, FDA) underpin its product reliability. Additionally, Dirui’s localization strategy and extensive international registrations provide competitive advantages in both domestic and global markets.
